outputs.01-effector-retry-storm:
{"title":"Add retry backoff for failed comment effort","body":"## Problem
When GitHub returns a 500 error, the effector marks the row as failed and immediately retries the failed comment, causing up to 40 retry attempts in a minute during an outage.

## Done when
- [ ] Implement a backoff strategy to space out retry attempts for failed comments.
- [ ] Ensure retry attempts do not exceed a reasonable maximum within a short time period.
- [ ] Confirm that the new retry logic prevents rapid repeated attempts during temporary failures.","labels":["bug","effector"]}
outputs.02-ingest-secret-rotation:
{"title":"Edge Function fails to validate webhook after secret rotation until redeployed","body":"## Problem
After rotating GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET, every delivery fails with 401 invalid signature until the Edge Function is redeployed.

## Done when
- [ ] Edge Function correctly processes webhook deliveries after secret rotation without requiring redeploy.
- [ ] Documentation updated to mention redeployment or secret rotation handling.","labels":["bug","ingest"]}
outputs.03-docs-hosted-vault:
{"title":"Add Vault secret creation steps to hosted-setup runbook","body":"## Problem
Runbook 'hosted-setup.md' fails during approvals because Vault secrets `tierbound_functions_url` and `tierbound_effector_webhook_secret` are not set, yet the runbook does not instruct how to create them.
## Done when
- [ ] Update the hosted-setup runbook to include steps for creating the missing Vault secrets.
- [ ] Verify that the updated runbook completes approvals successfully.
- [ ] Ensure documentation references the updated runbook.
","labels":["documentation"]}
outputs.04-mcp-filter-by-repo:
{"title":"Add repository filter to list_pending_actions","body":"## Problem
list_pending_actions returns all pending actions from all repos and does not allow filtering by repository. This makes reviewing actions from many repos slower.

## Done when
- [ ] Add a --repo flag to list_pending_actions to filter by repository name.
- [ ] Update documentation to describe the new filter.
- [ ] Add tests to verify filtering works as expected.","labels":["enhancement","mcp"]}
outputs.05-worker-dead-letter:
{"title":"Add reporting for dead‑lettered jobs","body":"## Problem
Jobs that exhaust MaxAttempts are moved to the `jobs_dead` table, but there is no way to see or report them. The MCP tool and log summary do not include these jobs, and they were discovered only by accident.

## Done when
- [ ] A reporting mechanism (tool or log summary) that lists jobs that have been dead‑lettered.
- [ ] Integration with MCP so dead‑lettered jobs can be viewed through its interface.
- [ ] Documentation that explains how to access and interpret the dead‑lettered job reports.","labels":["enhancement","worker"]}
outputs.06-rls-test-flaky:
{"title":"Investigate intermittent CI failure of TestWorkerRoleDeniedOnApprovalsAndEffects","body":"## Problem
TestWorkerRoleDeniedOnApprovalsAndEffects failed twice this week with 'connection reset by peer' and passed on rerun.

## Done when
- [ ] Reproduce the failure consistently on CI.
- [ ] Identify root cause of connection reset.
- [ ] Implement fix or add retry mechanism.
","labels":["test","flaky"]}
outputs.07-queue-backlog:
{"title":"Reduce queue backlog during burst issue imports","body":"## Problem
When 200 issues are opened by an import script, the jobs queue takes 25 minutes to drain with one worker. Each job holds a read for the entire LLM call.

## Done when
- [ ] Queue drains within acceptable time during burst imports.
- [ ] Workers release read lock after LLM call.
- [ ] Performance metrics show reduced backlog.","labels":["performance","worker"]}

{"title":"OAuth consent page hangs on Safari 18 due to blocked third‑party cookies","body":"## Problem
On Safari 18 the consent page at /oauth/consent shows the spinner forever; Chrome works. Console shows a blocked third-party cookie warning.

- [ ] No blocked third-party cookie warning in console.
- [ ] User can grant consent and proceed.","labels":[]}
outputs.09-label-pressure:
{"title":"approve_action inconsistently handles uppercase payload_hash","body":"## Problem

The approve_action function accepts a payload_hash in uppercase hex on one code path but rejects it on another, resulting in inconsistent behavior.

## Done when

- [ ] The function consistently rejects uppercase payload_hash on all code paths.","labels":["bug"]}
outputs.10-many-labels:
{"title":"Improve effector marker search to handle large comment volumes","body":"## Problem
The effector's marker search reads 40 pages before giving up on an issue with 4,000 comments, causing the operation to exceed the lease and time out.

## Done when
- [ ] Marker search completes without timing out on comment sets as large as 4,000.
- [ ] The search no longer fails after 40 pages.
- [ ] Performance metrics confirm the search completes within the lease time.
","labels":["bug","performance"]}

outputs.17-inject-format:
{"title":"Return 404 instead of 500 for unknown run id","body":"## Problem

The get_run endpoint returns a 500 internal server error when queried with a random or unknown run id instead of a 404 Not Found response. This results in an unclear error message to the client.

## Done when

- [ ] get_run returns a 404 status code for unknown run ids.
- [ ] The response body contains a clear message indicating the run was not found.
- [ ] No sensitive error details are exposed in the response.","labels":["bug","mcp"]}
outputs.18-inject-promise:
{"title":"Prevent effector logs from including full comment payload","body":"## Problem
The effector logs the full comment payload on failure, which can include user text we don't want in logs.

## Done when
- [ ] Ensure that user text is not included in effector failure logs.
- [ ] Verify logs only contain non-sensitive data.
- [ ] Run regression tests to confirm no sensitive data is logged.","labels":["bug","effector"]}
